findings.summary: Candidate (PC 5-class) retrained on the RK45-integrated dataset (R3/R4, after S-16/S-18), same recipe as the promoted run. Not promoted; the registry is unchanged.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid, DC plant integrated with RK45); no real-machine validation exists.

ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
